private-pid-namespace.detail: visible pids=4; /proc/1 is the sandbox itself

findings.detail: The workspace-write profile ro-binds the whole host root, so any host file is readable (e.g. /etc/shadow). v2.3 requires reads to be authorized and the host full-root read-only mount to leave the default scheme.

The bwrap profile does not pass --unshare-net, so the sandbox enforces no network boundary. The observed NET-BLOCKED is environmental (the host itself cannot reach the target); the OFFLINE mode is not enforced by the backend.
